title.en: Which sprayer prints 7 m³/h and grout?
title.zh: 哪台喷涂机印了 7 m³/h 和灌浆料？

description.en: The high-flow hydraulic sprayer: 380 V, 11/15 kW, 7 m³/h, 8 MPa, ≤ 8 mm, 150 m / 70 m. Materials listed: cement mortar, concrete, grout.
description.zh: 大流量液压喷涂机：380V、11/15 kW、7 m³/h、8 MPa、≤ 8 mm、150 m / 70 m。材料：水泥砂浆、混凝土、灌浆料。

h1.en: Which sprayer prints 7 m³/h and grout?
h1.zh: 哪台喷涂机印了 7 m³/h 和灌浆料？

directAnswer.en: The high-flow hydraulic concrete spraying machine. Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai prints 380 V, dual motors 11/15 kW, 7 m³/h, 8 MPa, hose 38/51 mm, sand-cement ratio ≤ 1:3, particle ≤ 8 mm, 150 m horizontal / 70 m vertical, 2500 × 1000 × 1100 mm and 650 kg. Applicable materials on that page are cement mortar, concrete and grout. It is not the 5 m³/h / 295 kg sprayer and not a trailer pump.
directAnswer.zh: 大流量液压混凝土喷涂机。邢台河北品锦机械印了 380V、双电机 11/15 kW、7 m³/h、8 MPa、管径 38/51 mm、砂灰比 ≤ 1:3、粒径 ≤ 8 mm、水平 150 m / 垂直 70 m、外形 2500 × 1000 × 1100 mm、650 kg。该页适用材料是水泥砂浆、混凝土和灌浆料。它不是 5 m³/h / 295 kg 的喷涂机，也不是拖泵。

heading.en: Grout does not mean a grout-pump catalogue
heading.zh: 灌浆料不等于单独的灌浆泵目录

body.en: The word is an applicable material on this spraying page. The site FAQ says listed pumps are not grout pumps as a separate product line. If the job is this sprayer’s grout material inside ≤ 8 mm and 7 m³/h, stay here. Do not invent a grout-pump model that is not published.
body.zh: 这个词是本喷涂页上的适用材料。网站问答写明已列泵不是单独的灌浆泵产品线。如果作业就是这台喷涂机在 ≤ 8 mm 和 7 m³/h 内的灌浆料，留在这里。不要编一台未公布的灌浆泵型号。

heading.en: 650 kg is the larger hydraulic frame
heading.zh: 650 kg 是更大的液压机架

body.en: The 5 m³/h hydraulic unit is 295 kg and 100 m / 50 m. This one is 650 kg and 150 m / 70 m. Both need 380 V. A floor that cannot take 650 kg is a reason to look at the 295 kg row, not a reason to change the particle limit.
body.zh: 5 m³/h 液压机是 295 kg、100 m / 50 m。这一台是 650 kg、150 m / 70 m。两台都要 380V。楼层放不下 650 kg 时，去看 295 kg 那一行，而不是去改粒径上限。

heading.en: What should Xingtai receive with the inquiry?
heading.zh: 向邢台询盘要带上什么？

body.en: If the material is grout, say so, and still send particle size and hose length. Send Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai the mix, the largest stone or particle, the output you need, the horizontal and vertical pipe you measured, and whether the site has grid voltage or must use diesel. Use /contact, the on-site WhatsApp button, PinjinHebei@Outlook.com or 19912003025. Do not attach a project name, a country job or a daily volume the catalogue does not print.
body.zh: 如果材料是灌浆料，请写明，并且仍然发送粒径和软管长度。 请把配合比、最大石子或粒径、需要的输送量、量到的水平与垂直管路，以及现场是电网还是必须用柴油，发给邢台的河北品锦机械。途径是 /contact、站内 WhatsApp、PinjinHebei@Outlook.com 或 19912003025。不要附上目录里没有的项目名称、国家工程或日浇筑方量。

answer.en: No. Horizontal is 150 m. Vertical is 70 m.
answer.zh: 不是。水平是 150 m。垂直是 70 m。

answer.en: No. M9 is plaster at 30 L/min and ≤ 4 mm.
answer.zh: 没有。M9 是 30 L/min、≤ 4 mm 的石膏机。

question.en: Is 7 m³/h a concrete pump output?
question.zh: 7 m³/h 是混凝土泵的输送量吗？

answer.en: It is this sprayer’s output cell. Trailer pumps print their own outputs, starting from other tables such as 8–10 m³/h on Electric 20.
answer.zh: 它是这台喷涂机的输送量格。拖泵有自己的输送量，例如电动20的 8–10 m³/h，在别的表上。
